name: sentinel-on-a-bit-length-field
reference: spec/engine-spec.md 0.19 (constrained whole number, padding) with 0.9 (absent) and ruling 22: x is the 8 bits ff, its sentinel, so x is absent; n is a constrained whole number in 0..7, 3 bits 000. Encode: x absent writes 255 (ff), n 0 writes 000, the 11 bits padded to two octets: ff00. Derived by hand.
